notes.title: Couch Co-op Fest 2025!
notes.notes:
We show off the unique multiplayer features that Youra holds. 
Fight together up to 4 players against the forces of evil. 
Discover the many mini games that Youra hides and play with friends there! 
Play the many multiplayer modes that Youra holds such as Pvp, Survival, adventure, and many more!

notes.title: Youra Dev Q&A
notes.notes: We will be playing through the game and discuss how the games current state is and all the features currently in the game. We will also speak more about what to expect for Youra in the future and what will be coming up

notes.title: Youra And its Future
notes.notes: Join us for an exciting live stream featuring the Youra demo! We’ll discuss its features, future plans, and delve into the captivating story behind Youra. Feel free to ask any questions you might have—we’re here to answer them! Your presence is highly valued, and we look forward to sharing this journey with you.
